The '''Titania Line''' was a fleet of ships serving the [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] during the [[DarkStryder Campaign]]. The fleet served in the [[Battle of Kathol System]], where its [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Titania]]'' suffered massive damage at the hands of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] naval officer [[Kursk Mal'ia]].

In addition to the ''Titania'', the Titania Line included the following ships.

*one [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruiser]]
*one [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]
*one [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]]

The fleet also had a complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] that came along with the ''Titania''.
